notes.title: Level Pack "To Expand" Free To All Players!
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0 is now live, and it includes:
[list]
[*]A free pack of 5 all-new levels, available once you've beaten the main story
[*]Bug fixes, performance updates, and additional controller support
[*]Weird new journal pages once you've beaten all 5 levels of "To Expand"
[/list]

Please let us know what you think of the new levels.  They're available through the photos in the menu room.  If you'd like to see more free level packs, please share the game and tell your friends about it!

Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy the update :)

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Free Level Pack Incoming!
notes.content:
A big disorderly update is in the pipes, including but not limited to:
[list]
[*] "To Expand" - a series of five all-new wit-testing, finger-blistering levels to further challenge those that have beaten the game
[*] new insight and/or secrets unlockable in your journal?!
[*] bug fixes and performance improvements
[*] additional third-party controller support
[/list]

You'll be able to get your hands on all of this goodness very soon!
Keep your eyes peeled and fingers at the ready!
